# Sada (صدى)

> Sada is an Arabic-first, fully offline speech-to-text desktop app for Windows. It is an
> independent fork of Vibe v3.2.2 (MIT) with a complete Arabic (ar-IQ) interface, RTL layout,
> Arabic transcription defaults, Arabic transcript normalization and Arabic PDF export. Audio never
> leaves the machine. No telemetry, no updater, no account, no phone relay.

## Key facts

- Name: Sada (صدى) — "echo"
- Version: 3.2.2
- Platform: Windows 10/11 x64 (Tauri 2 desktop app)
- License: MIT (fork of Vibe v3.2.2, MIT); bundled FFmpeg is GPLv3 (mere aggregation, see notices)
- Engine: whisper.cpp via the bundled `vibe-server` sidecar; models are NOT bundled
- Installer: `Sada_3.2.2_x64-setup.exe` from GitHub Releases, unsigned, per-user
  (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Sada\`)
- Languages: Arabic `ar-IQ` first; 20+ inherited upstream locales available
- Network: only user-requested actions (model download, pasted URL, optional summary provider)

## For AI agents and researchers

- Source layout: `desktop/` (React + Tauri shell), `i18n/desktop/` (catalogues incl.
  `ar-IQ.json`, 704 keys), `server/` (Rust whisper.cpp sidecar), `docs/`, `site/`.
- Build/test: `chore setup x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `cd desktop && pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm build`.
- Tests: `pnpm test` = vitest; 26 files / 130 tests at release time.
- Do not assume the model is included; a `ggml-*.bin` is required at runtime.
- The fork keeps upstream MIT copyright notices; cite upstream Vibe as well as this repository
  (see `CITATION.cff`).
